scope: Reviewed ordinary player commands in the retained native engine. Hosting, sharing defaults and machine-side update controls are documented separately; review does not imply deployment or actual-provider acceptance.

commands.title: Double Time selection
commands.availability: Ranked Standard from v6.7.11; unavailable in Mania, Loved or incompatible fixed-mod rooms.
commands.permissions: Active gameplay player or moderator; public command policy applies.
gates: Public commands may be disabled; public rate limits apply.
Verified DT catalog and current native Ranked chart checksum are required.
commands.timing: Plain .dt adds mixed DT eligibility for future picks at any star range and preserves the queue. From v6.7.14, .dt 100 (also .dt 100%) prefers every pick DT with fresh eligible NoMod fallback and safely refreshes unplayed upcoming NM after a server audit. A running match/countdown finishes first. Plain .dt restores mixed selection; .nm opts out. Automatic eligibility starts above a 5.5-star active-window midpoint. Overrides reset with the empty-room session.
commands.summary: Allow mixed DT with .dt or prefer every pick DT with .dt 100 and NoMod fallback. Uses verified actual DT difficulty, played duration and repeat safeguards. Plain reply: dt enabled, buckle up gamers | Disable with .nm

commands.title: NoMod picks only
commands.availability: Ranked Standard mixed-DT rooms from v6.7.11.
commands.permissions: Active gameplay player or moderator; public command policy applies.
gates: Public commands may be disabled; public rate limits apply.
commands.timing: Keeps DT off at any star range until the empty-room session reset. Unplayed DT items are removed/replaced at a safe boundary; NM queue and played history remain. Running DT finishes normally. A DT countdown is cancelled only after a confirmed server acknowledgement. If no eligible NM replacement exists, start is held.
commands.summary: Opt out of DT and request NoMod picks only without aborting a running match.

commands.title: Language help
commands.availability: All lobbies from v6.7.9; Japanese, Polish, Indonesian, French and German from v6.7.19
commands.permissions: Own preference only; English-only reset remains available when ordinary room commands are disabled. Public rate limits apply.
gates: English is always first; shared announcements stay English.
Only supported, compact personal replies have prepared translations; missing or overlong translations fall back to English.
commands.timing: Choice follows the player across rooms. Country can suggest a language in requested general help only. Fresh consistent chat can trigger one quiet opt-in offer, globally spaced five minutes apart; neither switches automatically.
commands.summary: Choose Mandarin, Korean, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Indonesian, French or German personal guidance alongside English. en/off returns to English-only and dismisses offers.

commands.summary: Show approximately how much time is left in the running map; mid-match join messages include a short .time hint.

Solo behavior and referee safety checks remain.

commands.summary: Vote to skip the current map.

gates: Public commands may be disabled; public rate limits apply.
commands.timing: Separate styles with spaces, commas, pipes, slashes, +, or &; existing aliases work. Variety alongside a specific style is ignored. Future picks favor charts matching every requested style, then the most matches with the fewest unrelated patterns. The visible queue stays unchanged. From v6.7.6, Rice/Noodle can combine with patterns; Rice keeps its composition boundary; from v6.7.15 Noodle falls back to native LN after strict and relaxed fresh Noodle choices run out, replacing the v6.7.7 Stream fallback. Rice and Noodle cannot be combined.
commands.summary: Inspect or request one or more Mania styles for future picks.

features.title: Successful-clear preference
features.summary: From v6.7.17, eligible Standard, Loved and Mania maps receive a 1.0–1.5 times pick-weight factor using osu!'s global pass count cached from official API metadata, not local lobby results, total attempts or DT-only clears. The reference is the current fresh eligible pool maximum, not the whole database. Feedback, styles, duration bias, DT mixing and repeats remain intact.
features.availability: Standard, Loved and Mania rooms running v6.7.17 or later; applies to new selections only

features.title: Fewer long-note Variety picks
features.summary: Native 4K and 7K Mania Variety gives LN- or Noodle-classified charts one-tenth their former relative selection weight. This is not a fixed percentage of rounds and does not remove maps or change hard filters. Existing feedback, farm bonuses, duration bias and repeat spacing remain. Explicit style sources including LN, Noodle and Farm keep their existing selection behavior. Already queued maps are not replaced.

features.title: Mixed Standard DT
features.summary: DT is automatically eligible above an active star-window midpoint of 5.5 stars; .dt opts in anywhere and .nm opts out. DT uses actual calculated difficulty, speed-adjusted duration and verified chart revisions. Outside Jump, from v6.7.13 its preferred minimum is divided by 1.5 while the preferred upper bound stays unchanged: default DT preference is 60–150 played seconds, versus NoMod 90–150. Shorter maps can still appear occasionally. The hard cap uses played time, so a 270-second source chart plays for 180 seconds with DT and can appear occasionally under a 240-second cap. Existing JSON duration settings apply. From v6.7.20, Jump instead prefers under 90 played seconds with no minimum and perceived AR 9–10, both softly. Per-item required mods restore normal speed on NoMod items; NoMod remains the majority in ordinary mixed mode when both pools are fresh. From v6.7.14, .dt 100 prefers every pick DT with fresh eligible NoMod fallback, safely refreshes unplayed upcoming NM, and permits consecutive DT; .dt restores mixing. Repeat and hard filters remain; Mania is unchanged.

features.title: How a match starts and finishes
features.summary: Rounds move through waiting, countdown, gameplay and scoring. From v6.7.18, rooms with at least two gameplay players need only one ready player; nobody ready means waiting. Newly unready players share one extra five seconds once per stay.

features.title: The visible queue and future selections
features.summary: The visible queue contains already selected maps; preference changes affect later selections.

features.title: Map filters, freshness, and feedback
features.summary: Pool eligibility, freshness, player feedback and mode-specific preferences work together. Standard pools below 50 eligible maps progressively relax passes down to 1,000 if needed, preserving stars, hard duration, age and source. From v6.7.20, Jump uses weighted snap-aim variety rather than highest-score-only selection, with separate soft short-length and perceived-AR preferences. Mania is unchanged.
features.availability: All lobbies; filters vary by room

features.title: Automatic and fixed difficulty
features.summary: Automatic rooms adapt their baseline; fixed rooms use a baseline that players can influence through votes.
features.availability: All lobbies; automatic adaptation in Standard Room 1

features.title: Skip, replay, and difficulty voting
features.summary: Skip, replay, and difficulty voting resolve shared room decisions using current eligible players.
features.availability: Active gameplay participants; staff policy applies

features.title: Good, bad, and neutral feedback
features.summary: Positive, negative and neutral feedback record how players judged the last completed map. Distributed installations retain local feedback and may explicitly synchronize eligible human contributions through their configured owner hub. Sharing permissions and local/shadow policy remain operator-controlled; network failures retain local selection and queued feedback.
features.availability: All lobbies; last completed map and feedback window. Distributed sharing requires explicit enrollment and sharing policy.

features.title: Mania styles
features.summary: Structural style preferences for native Mania now require sustained pattern evidence; labels can still overlap. Rice and Noodle use existing note-composition evidence from v6.7.6.
features.availability: Mania 4K and 7K; active players select preferences

features.title: Style exhaustion and fallback
features.summary: Strict fresh styles precede weaker evidence. Rice retains its bounded composition. From v6.7.15, strict fresh Noodle then relaxed Noodle precede classified native LN fallback before a recent repeat; this replaces the v6.7.7 Stream tier. Hard room filters and native keys remain. The v6.7.17 pass-count factor changes weights within eligible tiers, not fallback order.

features.title: Experimental Mania Farm
features.summary: Experimental farm evidence ranks eligible fresh charts without promising a particular PP return.
features.availability: Mania 4K and 7K; staff enablement and validated evidence

features.title: Vetted Mania converts
features.summary: Standard converts require independently verified actual Mania columns and a recalculated converted rating. Both converted and source-display ratings must fit the room range. Missing or mismatched evidence uses native maps only; admitted conversions require the matching key mod and disable difficulty/ruleset switching.
features.availability: Mania Variety only; matching verified key mode, catalog revision and difficulty evidence. The eleven legacy incorrectly labelled 4K converts are quarantined.

features.title: PP estimates
features.summary: PP commands give informational map estimates at requested accuracies and supported mods.
features.availability: All lobbies; supported mods and calculator availability

features.title: Statistics and privacy
features.summary: Local and shared confirmed statistics preserve account privacy, overlap deduplication and bounded cache freshness.
features.availability: All lobbies; statistics visibility belongs to the player

features.title: Independent room updates
features.summary: Signed compatible worker updates wait individually; shared controllers wait for all configured rooms; initial storage migrations remain stopped and reviewed.
features.availability: After v6.7 adoption; compatible releases and an empty/idle safety window

features.title: English-first language help
features.summary: English-first prepared help, welcome, timing and style replies support nine additional languages: Chinese, Korean, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Indonesian, French and German. DT/NM confirmations are translated. Explicit choices and opt-in hints persist; a configured room language supplies the initial default, safe English fallback remains, and shared announcements stay English.
features.availability: All lobbies with the prepared language module; personal choices override the configured room default.

features.title: Starting without waiting for AFK players
features.summary: With at least two gameplay players, one ready player is enough for an automatic start or .start. Newly unready players share one extra five seconds on their first countdown per stay, then do not delay later maps. With nobody ready, the room waits. Solo behavior is unchanged; spectators and referees are excluded.
features.availability: All lobbies from v6.7.18; at least two gameplay players
